artworks.title: Mezzetin and Harlequin Use the Picture Frame to Catch Pantaloon and Pierrot
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper; scored for transfer
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white drawing showing several figures engaging in a chaotic theatrical scene. The illustration features figures in period costumes, with exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses. On the left, a figure resembling a harlequin leans back dramatically with a bow, while another figure thrusts an easel and canvas in front of them. In the center, an artist holds a palette and brushes, pointing animatedly. On the right, more figures are engaged; a masked character observes, while another playfully peeks around a corner. The backdrop includes draped curtains and classical architecture.

artworks.title: Pantaloon and the Doctor Fighting with Columbine and Brigatella in the Garden
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper; scored for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring figures engaged in a confrontation. The image shows a male figure with a sword and a hat facing off against a female figure holding a shield. The setting includes arches, potted plants, and an ornate garden or courtyard, evoking depth. Shadowing and detailing emphasize movement and tension in the tableau.

artworks.title: Seated Sibyl
artworks.medium: brush and brown, blue, and gray ink over black chalk and graphite, heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a person shown from the head down to the feet with their body turned slightly sideways, facing upward. The individual is seated, with one knee raised and arms clasped together on the knee. Their head is tilted back, gazing upwards. The person has a serene facial expression with faint details in the facial features. They are adorned with a wrap or cloth that partially covers their head like a turban, with fabric draping around their body. The clothing is flowing and voluminous, with visible folds and creases indicating a robe-like garment. There is a spiral decorative element near the foot. The background of the image is plain, with subtle shading that lends depth but does not depict any distinct surroundings or setting.

artworks.title: Magnificent Catafalque for a Deceased Noble
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural structure. The image features a grand altar or stage with intricate and ornate Baroque influences. The structure is highly decorative, with scrolling lines, floral motifs, and detailed sculptures. At the top, there is a triangular pediment adorned with intricate designs and flanked by two statues. The central part of the structure includes a niche or sacred space. The base consists of stairs leading up to the altar, and the entire structure is framed by ornate columns.

artworks.title: Ancient Roman Warriors Riding into Battle
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with figures on horseback. The monochromatic drawing depicts dynamic movement and intense action. The foreground shows figures riding horses carrying staffs or standards. The background shows more riders and possibly foot soldiers engaged in combat. The scene conveys chaos and motion, capturing the energy of a battlefield. White highlights on brown-toned paper add depth and emphasize the figures and their steeds.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular, bearded figure and a large serpent-like creature engaged in a struggle. The figure leans over a precipice with a sheet or drape billowing behind. The background features rocky formations or clouds created with light hatch and wash techniques. The pose and line work convey tension and confrontation.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in a dynamic composition against a natural backdrop. The figure on the left is reclining on a large irregular-shaped structure and is dressed in flowing garments. Their facial features are delicate, they have long hair, and a contemplative expression. The figure on the right appears to be in motion with an outstretched arm reaching forward. Their hair is wavy, and their expression is intense. The background includes stylized, swirling clouds and sparse tree-like formations, enhancing the scene's ethereal quality. An object resembling a scroll is held loosely by the reclining figure, adding to the classical and narrative feel of the artwork.

artworks.title: A Desert Hermit Adoring the Crucifix
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a contorted human figure in flowing garments against a backdrop of sharp peaks resembling cliffs or mountains. The figure is depicted with expressive brushstrokes, creating a sense of motion and tension. The color palette is muted with grays and browns, contrasted by dark outlines. Soft curves in the distance contrast the foreground elements.

artworks.title: The Dead Christ with Angels
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical scene. The drawing depicts a reclining figure draped in flowing fabric, set against a background of rolling clouds and rugged terrain. The central figure is lying in a graceful pose. Around the figure are elements that resemble armor or shields. In the background, there are other figures in dynamic postures. The clouds above add grandeur and atmosphere. The work is rendered with skillful linework and shading to depict depth and highlight contrasts.

artworks.title: A Kneeling Man Holding a Staff [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a person in a crouched position, supported by one knee and one outstretched arm. The person's facial features are not detailed. The hair is curly or wavy, following the curve of the head. The clothing appears loose-fitting with visible folds and creases. The background is plain, with the focus on the charcoal figure on lightly-toned paper.

artworks.title: A Female Nude [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a reclining male figure. Parts of the body are drawn, showing a muscular arm and torso, as the figure lies on his side facing upwards. Facial features are barely visible, and no clear hair details are shown. The sketch lacks detailed clothing, outlining only the body's form. A cross-shaped mark is present to the left of the figure. The background is a plain, slightly textured surface with a light gray tone and faint discolorations and marks.

artworks.title: Orlando Rescuing Oliver from the Lion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 45.6 x 55.4 cm (17 15/16 x 21 13/16 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 86.4 cm (26 x 34 in.)
artworks.description: The drawing is from a side view, slightly elevated. The horizon is vague, and the composition leads the eye along a large gnarly tree trunk. There are two dynamic figures, one standing with a sword and the other lying on the ground. The drawing has loose brushstrokes and a limited color palette with sepia tones and black ink lines, creating contrast between the figures and the background. Clouds are lightly sketched in the distance.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Cave
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nude elderly man seated on a rock with a draped cloth covering his lower body. He is holding a long stick and appears to be examining it closely. There is a lion lying calmly to the left of him. In the background, there is a dark, arched cavern-like ceiling with two hanging objects and foliage details.

artworks.title: Villa Madama a Rome
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown wash over graphite on cream wove paper; laid down on mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the floor plan of Villa Madama in Rome. The image features architectural plans at the center surrounded by decorative borders. The borders include cherubs, classical motifs, heraldic symbols, and a coat of arms held by two winged putti at the top. An inscription reads "VILLA MADAMA A ROME VII CAHIER." The drawing emphasizes symmetry and ornate design elements, showcasing architectural precision and decorative artistry.

artworks.title: Adriaen van Swieten
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 7.6 cm (3 in.)
sheet: 8.4 x 5.8 cm (3 5/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right of the viewer with his head turned partially towards the viewer in a three-quarter profile. The man has a mature face with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly and voluminous hair. He is depicted wearing a high-collared garment with a ruffled collar and a buttoned vest. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. An oval border surrounds him with accompanying writing. A heraldic shield with various elements, including a bird on top of a helmet, is next to him. The background features a textured pattern to emphasize the central figure.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 7 cm (2 3/4 in.)
sheet: 17.5 x 11.7 cm (6 7/8 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting three figures from the waist up. On the left, a woman with delicate facial features and wavy hair tied back with a headscarf sits; her hair is adorned with a band of beads. She is shown in profile, gazing downwards, and wears a draped garment. To her right is an infant, seated on her lap, with a chubby face and curly hair. The child is reaching upwards towards a man standing next to them, who is bending forward slightly. The man has a beard and short hair, and his facial expression appears attentive as he offers a small branch with leaves to the child. His clothing is loose-fitting with an ample shawl. The background is sketched with branches and leaves.

artworks.title: The Wedding of Cupid and Psyche
artworks.medium: engraving from three plates printed on three sheets of attached laid paper
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.title: The Port of Monaco
artworks.medium: charcoal, black chalk, and gray wash heightened with white chalk on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with sailboats docked alongside a pier. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky and cliffs. The artwork features delicate line work detailing the boats, cliffs, and surroundings with a muted blue and grey color palette. Buildings and people are depicted in the distance.

artworks.title: The Port of Monaco
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several sailboats moored in water viewed from a dockside perspective. The horizon is high in the image with water stretching towards it. On the left, tree-covered terrain rises towards a structure on a hill. The image uses an etching technique with detailed line work to convey texture. The color palette is sepia, creating a historical appearance with subtle gradations.

artworks.title: A Singular Rock in Dove-Dale named the Pickerell
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on laid paper; laid down on original mount
artworks.description: The image depicts towering rock formations with intricate details and textures. The scene shows cliffs, mountains, vegetation, and a stream at the base. The color palette includes earthy tones, vibrant foliage, and a soft blue sky. Small figures can be seen in the distance, adding scale to the scene.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut with gouache and gold leaf (incised and stamped) on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in various poses. In the center, a person is nailed to a cross in a crucifixion position, with a cloth around the waist, a crown of thorns, and a halo. To the left stands another person in a blue robe, and to the right stands a person in a reddish-brown garment. In the foreground, there are rocks, a skull, and green ground. The background features a gilded surface with ornamental patterns and a blue outline. Below the image is decorative text.

artworks.title: A Venetian Courtyard, in the Procuratie Nuove
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural view of a courtyard in a classical building. The perspective is upward, focusing on the facade which has multiple stories, columns, and ornate windows. The style is precise with detailed architectural elements. The color palette consists of earthy browns and grays, giving the scene an aged look. In the courtyard, there are figures in period attire standing and conversing. The scene is framed by columns, leading the eye towards the building.

artworks.title: Arnout van Beresteyn
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth and Joseph Bromberg in memory of their son, Michael
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man. He is slightly turned to his left and looking confidently at the viewer. The man has defined facial features with a mustache and a beard. His hair is styled neatly and short, receding slightly at the forehead. He is dressed in elaborate Renaissance clothing, including an ornate ruffled collar and a detailed garment. The background is plain, and the image is framed in an oval with an inscription that includes "AETA 23," indicating his age at the time of the portrait's creation.

artworks.title: The Turret-Ship
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.7 x 17.6 cm (5 x 6 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Anita and Julius L. Zelman
artworks.description: The image shows a wide expanse of sea with sailing vessels on the horizon. The scene includes various masts and sails, created using delicate line work. The depiction uses a monochromatic color palette with dark lines contrasted against a light beige background. The foreground features open water, while the background shows a bustling nautical scene with ships and rigging.
